news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.7% a week. This is considered a minor risk. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. news.title: Shree Krishna Paper Mills & Industries Ltd. Appoints Mrs. Devika Ohri as Non-Executive Independent Director, Effective November 1, 2025
news.body: Shree Krishna Paper Mills & Industries Ltd. has appointed Mrs. Devika Ohri (DIN: 10399161) as a Non-Executive Independent Director of the Company for a term of five consecutive years commencing from November 1, 2025 to October 31, 2030, not liable to retire by rotation. The appointment was approved by the Members through Postal Ballot and deemed to have been passed on the last date of remote E-Voting, January 15, 2026. The e-voting result for such appointment was declared on January 16, 2026. Mrs. Devika Ohri holds a Bachelor's Degree in Economics from Delhi University. She leads an advisory practice specializing in leadership coaching, succession and culture.
